verdict.rationale: The only event-related evidence is Automations, which run the Copilot cloud agent on a schedule or in response to repository events such as an issue being opened. That makes Copilot an event consumer. Nothing shows users subscribing to Copilot events through outbound webhooks. missing for 10: documented webhook subscriptions for Copilot or agent-session events, delivery to external endpoints, a list of event types and payloads, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
